_comment: One place for everything the owner is likely to change. Rename the product by changing site.name. See docs/launch/website.md.

site.name: Appbuilder
site.tagline: Business apps for your whole team, on your own server.
site.taglineHi: आपकी पूरी टीम के लिए बिज़नेस ऐप्स, आपके अपने सर्वर पर।

forms._comment: endpoint: null keeps forms on the mailto: fallback. Set to an HTTPS URL that accepts a POST of form fields to switch every form to it. Only do that once the privacy notice names the processor.

pricing._comment: Set price to a number (per year, in currency) to show it; null shows 'Talk to us'. pilotNote shows while any price is null.
pricing.pilotNote: Pilot pricing: talk to us. Prices are not decided yet; design partners get pilot terms in writing before anything is installed.

bands.name: Up to 25 people
bands.note: One install, up to 25 named users with passes.

bands.name: Up to 50 people
bands.note: One install, up to 50 named users with passes.

bands.name: Up to 100 people
bands.note: One install, up to 100 named users with passes.

passes.name: Full user
passes.desc: Builds and uses apps (with the Maker role), sees every app their roles allow.

passes.name: Operator
passes.desc: Uses the apps they are given: data entry, checklists, their own tasks.

passes.name: External
passes.desc: Someone outside the organisation, such as a supplier or customer. Needs the external portal, which is planned.

roi._comment: Defaults for the ROI estimator. All are visible and editable by the visitor.

analytics._comment: null = no analytics script at all. See docs/launch/website.md before turning this on.
